    induction a with
    | zero => intro b h; omega
    | succ a ih =>
      intro b h
      have h0 := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a
      cases h0 with
      | inl h0 =>
        subst h0
        rw [Nat.zero_add, Nat.one_mul]
        exact Nat.le_refl b
      | inr hp0 =>
        calc b ≤ a * b := ih b (by omega)
          _ ≤ a * b + 1 * b := Nat.le_add_right _ _
          _ = (a + 1) * b := (Nat.add_mul a 1 b).symm
  have mono : ∀ m, L p q m ≤ L p q (m+1) := by

    cases m with
    | zero => simp [L]
    | succ m' =>
      cases m' with
      | zero => simp [L, hp]
      | succ k =>
        calc L p q (k+2) ≤ p * L p q (k+2) := mulGE p _ hp
          _ ≤ p * L p q (k+2) + q * L p q (k+1) := Nat.le_add_right _ _
          _ = L p q (k+3) := L_succ_succ p q (k+1)

    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>

      have hm : m = 0 := by omega

    | succ k ih =>

    | nil => intro x _ _; exact trivial
    | cons y ys ih =>

    intro t
    induction t with
    | leaf => intro x _; simp [Tree.insert, Tree.inorder, ins]

      by_cases hxy : x ≤ y
